Messages.Author: Chris Shorb & Tammy Martin
Messages.Body:
The errata say that capacity is lost if a prince loses
his/her title that s/he gained with a praxis seizure. What
if instead that same prince gained the exact same title?
I.e. Dr. John Casey is Praxis Barcelona, and then gets voted
Praxis Barcelona again - is he a 4 or 5 cap vampire?

Thanks for any feedback.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris Shorb & Tammy Martin wrote:
> The errata say that capacity is lost if a prince loses
> his/her title that s/he gained with a praxis seizure. What
> if instead that same prince gained the exact same title?
> I.e. Dr. John Casey is Praxis Barcelona, and then gets voted
> Praxis Barcelona again - is he a 4 or 5 cap vampire?

He loses a capacity from the lost title and gains a capacity from
the new title. So he's 3+1-1+1 = 4.
